final: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS active_customers, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE active = 1) AS share_of_total, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE active = 1) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) FROM customer WHERE active = 1)) AS relative_to_avg FROM customer WHERE active = 1 GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
